row.body: Monday morning: two workers from the seed trial carried an oily film. my eyes began burning before the county van arrived.
row.title: Monday morning — an oily film

sidecar.gloss: A personal trace connects a farm trial to symptoms before a later restriction.
sidecar.rival_reading: Emergency workers could have picked up the same an oily film while responding near a field; this personal trace does not prove the trial caused the emergency.
